\[
f(x)=a(x+1)^2+2.

0=a(1+1)^2+2=4a+2 \quad\Rightarrow\quad a=-\frac12.
\]

\[
\boxed{f(x)=-\frac12(x+1)^2+2=-\frac12x^2-x+\frac32}.
\]
